newsitem.title: USA: Nalco Q4 water/waste treatment sales up.
newsitem.headline: Nalco Q4 water/waste treatment sales up.

text.p: Nalco Chemical Co said Monday fourth quarter sales in its water and waste treatment segment rose 17 percent to $108.7 million from $92.8 million a year ago.
Water and waste treatment revenues for the fourth quarter included sales from Diversey Water Technologies, which Nalco acquired for $82 million in June 1996.
Since then, Nalco has completed acquisitions with combined annual sales of nearly $100 million, primarily in the water and waste treatment market, a spokesman said.
Process chemical sales gained 10 percent to $90.8 million from $82.5 million a year ago, with the pulp and paper process chemicals and general industry recording strong results, it added.
Nalco's Latin American division showed a 15 percent rise in sales to $28.0 million from $24.4 million, with operations in Mexico, Venezuela and Chile recording double-digit increases.
Nalco's sales in Europe gained five percent to $72.4 million from $68.7 million.

Sales in the Pacific region dropped four percent to $39.8 million from $41.3 million. Excluding amounts in 1995 that were transferred to a joint venture between Nalco and Exxon Energy Chemicals LP, an Exxon Corp unit, fourth quarter sales in the Pacific gained eight percent.
Earlier, Nalco reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.60 a primary share, up from $0.53 a year ago. Earnings from continuing operations rose to $0.56 a share from $0.48.
